art_direction.theme: Developer Terminal / Command-Line Meets Avant-Garde Dark Aesthetic
art_direction.archetype: Architectural Tech & Signal Cyber (Swiss High-Contrast + Dark Neo-Brutalist Terminal)

key_features_and_components.name: Kinetic Hero Section with Masked Line-by-Line Reveal
key_features_and_components.description: Bold headline text with line-by-line overflow-hidden masked reveal animation using Framer Motion. Embedded signature prompt string (e.g., '>_ NEEL RUPARELIYA'). Includes quick bio, key stats counters (4+ Years Exp, 40% Automation Boost, 100+ Projects, MCA Degree), CTA buttons ('Explore CLI Terminal', 'Initiate Project'), and live status badge ('STATUS: Available for Automation & Architecture Work').

key_features_and_components.name: Three.js Interactive 3D Hero Object
key_features_and_components.description: Interactive 3D geometry canvas floating alongside or behind hero title. Features rotating wireframe dodecahedron / particle cyber core reacting smoothly to mouse move cursor coordinates.

key_features_and_components.name: Slow Editorial Marquee Strip
key_features_and_components.description: Drifting kinetic banner with monospace & display text separator showing core specializations: 'PYTHON AUTOMATION • PINE SCRIPT WEBSOCKETS • TELEGRAM BOT API • FLASK BILLING PIPELINE • ASYNC ARCHITECTURE'.

key_features_and_components.name: Developer Profile Code Card
key_features_and_components.description: Syntactically highlighted IDE window component with code editor header (buttons, tab 'neel_profile.py'). Displays real Python code object defining Neel's skills, background, tech stack dictionary, and executed output log in real-time.

key_features_and_components.name: System Architecture Flow Diagram Section
key_features_and_components.description: Interactive visual pipeline representing the automated workflow: TradingView Indicator Access & Lifecycle Management (Flask Billing API → Webhook Dispatcher → Pine Script Server → Telegram Bot API). Includes pulse animation on connector lines, node status badges, and interactive click-to-inspect details for each architecture node.

key_features_and_components.name: Bento-Style Featured Projects Grid
key_features_and_components.description: Asymmetric Bento Grid showcasing major software products (Trade Masters, Market Chart Automation & Telegram Alerts, ProofAI, Kahanan Jewels). Features 3D tilt hover effects, metric badges (e.g. '10k+ Trades/Day', '99.9% Uptime'), tech stack tags, demo/code modal drawers, and visual preview cards.

key_features_and_components.name: Work Experience Timeline
key_features_and_components.description: High-contrast technical timeline for Python Developer Intern at LiBest Solutions, Bhavnagar (Nov 2023 – May 2024). Includes key achievements, automated script highlights, and impact metrics.

key_features_and_components.name: Technical Skills & Stack Matrix Grid
key_features_and_components.description: Categorized grid covering Languages (Python, Pine Script, SQL, JavaScript), Frameworks & Libraries (Flask, FastAPI, Selenium, PyTest, Pandas), Databases & Storage (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis), Automation & DevOps (Docker, Git, Webhooks, Telegram API, Cron Jobs), and Developer Tools (VS Code, Postman, Linux CLI).

key_features_and_components.name: Degrees & Credentials Section
key_features_and_components.description: Card deck presenting MCA (Master of Computer Applications) and BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications) with credential verification badges and specialization highlights.

key_features_and_components.name: Working Interactive Terminal CLI Section
key_features_and_components.description: Realistic dark terminal console component with custom command prompt (neel@automation-core:~$). Supports interactive typed commands: 'help', 'about', 'skills', 'projects', 'contact', 'architecture', 'clear', 'sudo hire-neel'. Output renders formatted terminal tables and links.

key_features_and_components.name: Contact Section - 'Let's Build Something Exceptional'
key_features_and_components.description: High-impact contact block featuring direct contact details (email: neelrupareliya59@gmail.com, phone: +91 81419 69437), location (Bhavnagar, India), social links (GitHub, LinkedIn, Telegram), and interactive form that connects to MongoDB via Python FastAPI backend with instant toast feedback.

layout_and_spacing_strategy.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/70 border border-emerald-500/20 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(16,185,129,0.05)] hover:border-emerald-500/50 transition-all duration-300

testing_and_accessibility_requirements.data_testid_policy: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, project cards, terminal input, links) MUST have explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the dark avant-garde developer command line aesthetic with signal green (#10B981) accents.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling and Framer Motion for line-by-line kinetic hero reveal and section entrance triggers.
Ensure Three.js / React Three Fiber interactive 3D canvas is embedded in the hero section with particle/geometry rotation and mouse position tilt.
Ensure the terminal CLI is fully functional with interactive typing, response rendering for 'skills', 'projects', 'contact', 'help', 'clear', and 'about'.
Ensure system architecture pipeline interactive diagram clearly displays Flask Billing API → Webhook Dispatcher → Pine Script Server → Telegram Bot API flow with pulsing data nodes.
Every clickable or focusable element must have a clear hover state and explicit data-testid attribute.
Verify contact form sends POST request to backend API storing messages in MongoDB, showing Sonner toast on success.
